name: Savar
home: House of the Mountain of Fire, Dravesa
found: House of the Mountain of Fire, writing to pilgrims.
and_yet: Warm to the touch. His eyes linger half a second too long.
sayings: Jorun’s pilgrimage was a good thing.
wants: Rakhmoth’s arrival. Recognition for the Schismatics.
dreams: Rakhmoth’s theology recognized before the Orthodox die out.
family: His family disowned him when he joined the Schismatics; a young son, Dav, being raised by his mother across town.
anecdotes: He quoted a man's own words back to him from three years prior, verbatim, mid-argument.
tragedies: Dav doesn't know who his father is.
